verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.96
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.96

verses.pali: 10. Asuravagga
verses.english: 10. Titans

verses.pali: Rāgavinayasutta
verses.english: Removing Greed

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
verses.english: One who practices to benefit themselves, but not others;

verses.pali: parahitāya paṭipanno no attahitāya,
verses.english: one who practices to benefit others, but not themselves;

verses.pali: nevattahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
verses.english: one who practices to benefit neither themselves nor others; and

verses.pali: attahitāya ceva paṭipanno parahitāya ca.
verses.english: one who practices to benefit both themselves and others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit themselves, but not others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual practices to remove their own greed, hate, and delusion, but doesn’t encourage others to do the same.

verses.pali: attanā dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
attanā mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit themselves, but not others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit others, but not themselves?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṁ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t practice to remove their own greed, hate, and delusion, but encourages others to remove theirs.

verses.pali: attanā na dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṁ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṁ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit others, but not themselves.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit neither themselves nor others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t practice to remove their own greed, hate, and delusion, nor do they encourage others to remove theirs.

verses.pali: attanā na dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṁ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit neither themselves nor others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
verses.english: And how does an individual practice to benefit both themselves and others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā ca rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s when an individual practices to remove their own greed, hate, and delusion, and encourages others to remove theirs.

verses.pali: attanā ca dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca dosavinayāya samādapeti;
attanā ca mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca mohavinayāya samādapeti.
Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
verses.english: That’s how an individual practices to benefit both themselves and others.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
